newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA SETS TEST FOR WORKING IN FINANCE SECTOR.
newsitem.headline: CHINA SETS TEST FOR WORKING IN FINANCE SECTOR.

text.p: China's top securities watchdog has ordered all people working in China's securities sector to pass a specialised test covering every aspect of the industry, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.

The China Securities Regulatory Commission has issued a programme covering the topics included in the test, ranging from basic knowledge, laws and rules, to supervision of the financial markets, the newspaper said.

The full text of the programme, published in the newspaper on Wednesday, shows the topics are divided into four major sections: basic knowledge of the financial industry, issues and underwriting of securities, securities trading and investment analysis of financial markets.
